scope: the eight CLI binaries at the versions pinned by workshop-images/showroom-terminal/cli-refresh.sh at 097fb62b, scanned as a directory rather than as an image
method: grype dir: over the exact vendor artifacts; skopeo v1.24.1 is source-built in the Containerfile and is not included here
residual_note: All three Criticals are GO-2026-6612 in golang.org/x/net, fixed only in v0.60.0. Red Hat ships oc/kubectl on v0.56.0 and roxctl on v0.58.0, so they cannot be cleared without rebuilding those binaries ourselves.

removed_by_this_bump.GO-2026-5064: containerd CRI checkpoint restore, absent on roxctl 5.0.0
removed_by_this_bump.GO-2026-5338: containerd CRI checkpoint import, absent on roxctl 5.0.0

publication_gate.configuration: anchore/scan-action, fail-build: true, severity-cutoff: high, only-fixed: true
publication_gate.result_on_this_projection: FAILS - 121 fixable High/Critical across the eight CLIs, 3 of them Critical
publication_gate.cannot_be_cleared_by_upgrading: kn 1.24.0, tkn 0.47.0, tkn-pac 0.54.0, opc 1.25.0 and helm 4.3.2 are the current upstream releases and still carry fixable High (stdlib go1.27.3 advisories fixed only in go1.27.4, x/net 0.61.0 fixed only in 0.62.0). oc, kubectl and roxctl are built and shipped by Red Hat on x/net v0.56.0/v0.58.0.
publication_gate.second_gate: the step after it runs scripts/check_backend_staging_security.py over the unfiltered report, which blocks on every High/Critical/Unknown regardless of fix state and hardcodes risk_acceptance: NOT-GRANTED
publication_gate.consequence: there is no artifact selection that makes this image publishable under the current gate; publication requires a signed exception path or dropping the prebuilt CLIs

what_this_does_not_establish: A directory scan is not an image scan. It says nothing about the pinned RHEL base layer, so it does not project the image's RPM residue. The 2026-10-20 scan of the previous build measured 81 High RPM matches there, but that used a five-week-older database; the rebuilt image's RPM count has to be measured, not assumed.
